description: The file is an HTML document that contains embedded Common Lisp source code for the CodeMirror editor mode for Common Lisp. It includes the source code for functions related to binary data manipulation in Common Lisp, as well as HTML and JavaScript for rendering an interactive code editor with syntax highlighting.

methods.name: integer-reader-name
methods.description: Generates a symbol name for an integer reader function based on byte size and signedness.

methods.name: integer-writer-name
methods.description: Generates a symbol name for an integer writer function based on byte size and signedness.

methods.name: write-bytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array to a stream.

methods.name: write-str
methods.description: Writes a null-terminated string to a stream, encoding it as necessary.

methods.name: read-bytes
methods.description: Reads a byte array of specified length from a stream.

methods.name: read-str
methods.description: Reads a null-terminated string from a stream.

methods.name: skip-bytes
methods.description: Skips a given number of bytes in a stream.

methods.name: ensure-socket-is-closed
methods.description: Ensures that a socket stream is closed, handling errors silently.
